adjudication.rationale: In `packages/lib/constants.ts`, `APP_CREDENTIAL_SHARING_ENABLED` is defined as `process.env.CALCOM_WEBHOOK_SECRET && process.env.CALCOM_APP_CREDENTIAL_ENCRYPTION_KEY`, which in TS evaluates to `string | undefined` (the second string when truthy), not a boolean. While the diff’s current usages treat it as a truthy/falsy flag (`if (!APP_CREDENTIAL_SHARING_ENABLED)`), exporting it with a non-boolean type can mislead downstream consumers into doing `=== true` checks that would never pass. A boolean coercion like `!!(A && B)` would avoid that pitfall.
